decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom extends the firm's deep scanning-phantom and dosimetry expertise into a growing niche, and the firm can interpret clinical feedback to refine it, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Small volume chambers sit squarely in the firm's core detector know-how and accredited calibration capability, and long clinical life cycles favour keeping them.
Small-field dosimetry demand continues to grow and the chamber builds on the same absorbed knowledge base, though overlap with Product B poses a slight consolidation risk.
A multi-model standard clinical chamber line is central to the established business and fully integrated into calibration and service routines.
The relative dosimetry chamber complements the firm's water phantoms and integrated QA workflows, drawing on closely related knowledge.
Thimble chambers are a long-standing core competence with long regulatory and clinical life cycles, so the firm will keep this one on the market.
